projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Here are some of my recent works
projects.description: A selection of projects demonstrating skills, tools and production examples.

docuchat-ai.title: DocuChat AI RAG - powered PDF chat app
docuchat-ai.description: A PDF chat application that lets you upload documents and ask questions, with cited page references and transparent source tracking.

task-board.title: Team Task Board: (Mini Jira)
task-board.description: Multi-tenant SaaS frontend with Supabase auth (password + magic link), realtime sync, RLS, TanStack Query caching, Zustand, mobile-first responsive UI, and GTM analytics.

good-news.title: Good News PWA: Filters & Bookmarks
good-news.description: Good News PWA provides an intuitive news browsing experience with advanced filtering, search, bookmarking, and infinite scrolling features. The app is optimized for performance and includes a smooth scroll-to-top function for effortless navigation across news articles.

payform-pro.title: PayForm Pro: Modular Razorpay Integration
payform-pro.description: PayForm Pro streamlines payment integration by offering a modular solution for secure form submissions and payment processing. It features a user-friendly frontend, robust backend API routes, and efficient data management with MongoDB.

zipsearch.title: ZipSearch: Postal Code Information App
zipsearch.description: ZipSearch is an interactive platform for exploring global postal code data. Leveraging the Zippopotam API, the app delivers seamless access to location-based information for data-driven searches.

pic-perfect.title: Pic Perfect: Realtime Image Optimization App
pic-perfect.description: Pic Perfect is a web application designed for real-time image optimization. It enables users to efficiently manipulate and optimize images, ensuring a fast and seamless experience.

portfolio.title: Geo-Targeted Portfolio App: Multilingual & SEO-Optimized
portfolio.description: Tanveer's Portfolio is a multilingual and SEO-optimized web app that showcases skills, projects, and achievements. Built with modern technologies, it offers an engaging and accessible experience for diverse audiences.

weather-app.title: Best Weather App
weather-app.description: Best Weather App delivers real-time weather updates with dynamic visuals that change based on current conditions. It offers accurate live data with an engaging interface.

blockbuster.title: Block Buster: Movie Reviews & Filters
blockbuster.description: Block Buster is a dynamic web application for movie reviews that combines filtering, sorting, and detailed movie insights. Designed for responsiveness and speed, it offers an engaging experience for film enthusiasts.
